download_plan.strategy: Download only archive parts required for the five selected sequences, then extract only matching entries.
download_plan.solid_archive_constraint: The required 7z files are solid archives. Selective extraction still requires downloading and scanning each complete required archive part.

download_plan.note: The archive total is a download/decompression cost, not the final extracted subset size. SMPL is auxiliary and will not be used as surface ground truth.

fit_eval_split_contract.timestamp: one RGB-reviewed stable frame per sequence; frozen in selected_sequences
fit_eval_split_contract.camera_a_role: FIT: RGB initializes SAM/MHR; registered sensor depth supplies the fitting observation
fit_eval_split_contract.camera_b_role: HELD_OUT_TEST: synchronized sensor depth is never passed to the optimizer
fit_eval_split_contract.fallback_if_no_valid_pair: Exclude the sequence with a recorded reason. Do not reuse Camera A pixels as held-out evidence and do not lower the gate.

explicit_exclusions.reason: The audited 339-sequence metadata did not contain the initially searched target action IDs, while HuMMan-Point supplied five candidate sequences and direct sensor depth.

claim_limit: This subset can test clothed/person-surface MHR fitability across five subjects. It cannot validate bare-back skin geometry, DMD37 locations, or medical accuracy.
visual_audit_finding: All five selections expose the posterior torso from Cameras 002 and 008. Four are straight-arm planks. The action-203 sequence is not true chest-down prone lying in the inspected capture; it is retained only as a complex unilateral-leg-raise support pose.
camera_pair_revision: Final RGB candidate: C008 FIT and C009 HELD_OUT after rejecting C002 and C007 for cropping. Registration review still required.
